channel.title: UNICEF Job Vacancies (Filtered)
channel.description: Filtered UNICEF job vacancies: Professional (P-1 to P-5), Director (D-1/D-2), internships and fellowships.

item.title: Chief Social & Behavior Change, (P-4), FT, #096672, Yaound - Republic of Cameroon, WCAR
item.description: Are you passionate about designing, managing and leading impactful Social and Behavioral Change strategies that advance children’s rights and strengthen community engagement? If so, this opportunity is for you.

item.title: Health Specialist (Emergency), P-4, Fixed Term Position, Kabul, Afghanistan, #00138034
item.description: UNICEF is seeking an experienced Health Specialist (Emergency) to lead and support emergency health programming for vulnerable women and children across Afghanistan. Reporting to the Chief of Health, the position plays a critical role in emergency preparedness, outbreak response, programme management, health systems strengthening, and coordination with government, UN agencies, NGOs, donors, and Health Cluster partners.

item.title: Deputy Representative Programme, )P-5), Freetown, Sierra Leone Fixed-Term #1657
item.description: A challenging and exciting opportunity has arisen within UNICEF Sierra Leonne Country Office for a passionate and committed Deputy Representative Programme at the P-5 level. The Deputy Representative reports to the CO Representative for general supervision and direction. The Deputy Representative serves as the principal adviser on the overall management of the CO, development of CO policies and strategies; and under delegated authority, for coordinating and managing all phases of the Country Office Programme, from formulation to delivery of results in accordance with UNICEF’s Strategic Plans, standards of performance and accountability framework, ethics, and integrity.

item.title: Senior Supply & Logistics Specialist, P-5, Fixed Term Position, Supply Division, Copenhagen, Denmark, #00023287
item.description: The ability of the Senior Supply and Logistics Manager to successfully advise and provide critical remote and physical support to emergency responses directly impacts on UNICEF’s ability to deliver results of children in complex emergency contexts. This in turn contributes to maintaining/enhancing the credibility of UNICEF as an effective and responsible manager of funds entrusted to the organization and to furthering UNICEF image as a competent organization for delivering cost effective and sustainable program results for children.

item.title: Nutrition Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, #00108531, Manila, Philippines, EAPR
item.description: Join UNICEF Philippines to lead one of UNICEF's largest and innovative nutrition programmes in the Region. Reporting to the Chief of Health and Nutrition, you will provide strategic and technical leadership to strengthen maternal and child nutrition, address all forms of malnutrition, including the growing burden of overweight and obesity, and support government-led systems strengthening.

item.title: Public Partnerships Specialist (P-3), Fixed Term Position, #00117185, Public Partnerships and Resource Mobilization Division, Washington DC, USA
item.description: The Partnerships Specialist contributes to strengthening UNICEF's strategic positioning with IFIs by monitoring institutional and political developments, identifying opportunities for policy influence, resource mobilization, and strategic collaboration, and supporting high-level engagement with senior partner counterparts. The position provides strategic analysis, partnership guidance, and coordination across the organization to ensure coherent and effective engagement with IFIs. The incumbent serves as a resource for colleagues on IFI-related partnership opportunities and contributes to positioning UNICEF as a trusted partner in advancing sustainable development outcomes for children.

item.title: Internship Recruitment: AI & Digital Innovation, Banjul, The Gambia (6 months)
item.description: Are you a student or recent graduate with a passion for technology, innovation, and problem-solving? This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the emerging field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digital innovation within a dynamic organizational environment. Whether you are looking to develop your digital skills, expand your understanding of AI, or gain meaningful workplace experience, this internship will provide a strong foundation for your future career.

item.title: Re-advertisement: Deputy Representative Programme, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Teheran, Iran (Islamic Rep. of), #00043581
item.description: The Deputy Representative supports the Representative on the overall management of the CO and for coordinating closely with the different programme sections on all phases of the Country Office Programme, from formulation to delivery of results in accordance with UNICEF’s Strategic Plans, standards of performance and accountability framework, ethics and integrity.

item.title: Chief Admin/Finance, P-4, FT, #00010180, New Delhi, India - APR
item.description: The Chief, Admin and Finance reports to the Deputy Representative, Operations (DRO) for general direction and guidance. The Chief is responsible for providing support to the DRO in managing monitoring and overseeing the full range of financial and administrative services in support of program and operational activities (i.e. financial planning, disbursements of funds and payments, treasury and accounting, financial analysis and reporting of resources, transport. travel and premises management, protocol administration), ensuring compliance of all financial and administrative operations with organizational plans, policies, procedures, guidelines, standards of performance, ethics and integrity.As the manager and functional expert of financial and administrative management services ln a large country office with thirteen field offices, the incumbent is accountable for provision of managerial leadership and policy guidance for achievement of effective service management and staff capacity development. Ensures management of staff for cost effective, quality and efficient administrative and financial operations in support of office operations and the country programmes.The Chief, Admin and Finance, when supervising support staff, will be responsible for planning and guiding work in progress and for reviewing work completed by subordinate staff to verify accuracy and compliance with Internal Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS), UNICEF Financial Regulations and Rules, policies, procedures, guidelines, standards of accountability and ethics.The role focuses on upstream engagement through systems strengthening, strategic partnerships, governance, and advancing UNICEF's 3Cs for Every Child approach—Convene, Converge, and Catalyze—to achieve sustainable improvements in administrative and financial management outcomes at scale.

item.title: Supply & Logistics Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, #00015131 Yangon - Myanmar, APR (Open for international candidates)
item.description: Fixed Term Vacancy Announcement for the post of Supply and Logistics Manager based in Yangon, Myanmar.

item.title: Consultoría - Actualización y Modernización del Plan Nacional para la Prevención, Detección Temprana, Control y Erradicación de la Influenza Aviar en Honduras bajo el Enfoque “Una Salud”, Tegucigalpa, Honduras (Remoto)#593485
item.description: UNICEF está buscando un Consultor/a para actualizar y modernizar integralmente el Plan Nacional para la Prevención, Detección Temprana, Control y Erradicación de la Influenza Aviaria en Honduras (2007) bajo estándares técnicos internacionales, integrando el enfoque multisectorial "Una Salud".

item.title: Re-advertisement: Partnerships Specialist (Muskoka Funds), P-3, Fixed Term Position, Dakar, Senegal, #00136587
item.description: The Muskoka Funds Initiative, a collaboration between UNICEF, UNFPA, UN Women, and WHO, has improved maternal and child health in six West and Central African countries since 2010, helping reduce maternal, neonatal, and under-five mortality while reaching tens of millions of women, children, and youth. As potential reductions in funding from the Government of France prompt its transition to a Muskoka Multi-Partner Trust Fund, a Partnerships Specialist role is intended to strengthen partnerships, mobilize new resources, and coordinate stakeholders to sustain and expand the initiative’s impact.

item.title: Finance Officer, P-2, Temporary Position, Div of Financial and Adm Mgmt, 10 months, Grant Management Unit/FRGM, Brusssels, Belgium #00138136
item.description: The United States Government remains UNICEF’s largest donor. Unlike many other donors whose funds are received in advance, the majority of US Government funding is provided to UNICEF on a reimbursement basis. The Finance Officer contribute directly to sustaining positive donor relations, strengthening UNICEF’s credibility with the US Government, and ensuring full compliance with the requirements of the relevant US Government bureaus. Effective management of US receivables supports the integrity, reliability, and accuracy of UNICEF’s financial statements. In addition, the technical support provided to Country Offices and the Global Shared Services Centre enhances grant management practices at the country level and improves the quality and accuracy of grant-related data and processes within the Grants Module.

item.title: Contracts Officer, P-2, Temporary Position, 364 days, Supply Division, COPENHAGEN, #00134584
item.description: Supply Division, Copenhagen is looking for a talent Contracts Officer for its Solar & Oxygen Unit of the Infrastructure and Energy Centre (IEC). The IEC plays a double role in Supply Division: It provides technical assistance to countries, SD Centres and Programmes, while at the same time acts as a procurement unit focused on delivering solar and oxygen solutions. This includes providing services that strengthen the delivery of sustainable health care services for child. If you are passionate by this job, please apply.

item.title: Chief Nutrition, P-5, Fixed Term Position, #00020954, Nairobi, Kenya
item.description: The Chief, Nutrition reports to the Deputy Representative for general guidance and direction. The Chief is responsible for managing and supervising all stages of the nutrition programme, from strategic planning and formulation to delivery of results. The Chief is also responsible for leading and managing the Nutrition team, along with strong collaboration with the Health and WASH sections on CSD imperatives, and other sections on cross-sectoral programmes. The Chief is accountable for ensuring that concrete and sustainable results in maternal, infant and child nutrition programmes are achieved in accordance with plans, allocation, results based-management approaches and methodology (RBM), as well as UNICEF’s Strategic Plans, standards of performance, and accountability framework.

item.title: Health Specialist (Social & Behavioral Change) Polio, P-4, TA (364 days), #138134, Abuja, Nigeria - WCAR
item.description: UNICEF Nigeria Country Office in Abuja, Nigeria is seeking a passionate and dynamic person to work in the role of Social Behaviour Change Specialist (Polio) and invites applications from highly motivated and committed persons who want to contribute to results for children. If you are that person, we encourage you to apply and become part of a highly motivated and committed team.

item.title: Programme Specialist, P-3, TA (6 months), #131824, Maputo, Mozambique - ESAR
item.description: We are recruiting a Programme Specialist P3 (Maputo based) to support UNICEF Mozambique’s strategic priorities by driving knowledge management, internal communications, risk follow-up and coordinated information flow across the Country Office and Field Offices, while preparing high quality briefs, SOPs and decision documents for senior leadership If you are passionate about delivering impactful results for children, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

item.title: WASH Specialist, P-3, FT, Sudan, Port Sudan - ESAR
item.description: The WASH Specialist (P-3) reports to the WASH Manager (P-4) and is responsible for providing technical leadership, programme management, and coordination support for UNICEF's WASH programme in Sudan. The incumbent leads the planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of WASH interventions to ensure the timely achievement of programme results, effective utilization of resources, and compliance with UNICEF policies, standards, and donor requirements.

item.title: WASH Specialist, P-3, FT, Port Sudan, Sudan - ESAR
item.description: The WASH Specialist (P-3) reports to the Chief of WASH (P-5) and is responsible for supporting the planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of UNICEF's WASH programme in Sudan. The incumbent provides technical and programmatic leadership for donor-funded and emergency WASH interventions, including the Dutch-funded project, KfW-supported programmes, and other humanitarian response activities. The Specialist ensures programme quality, compliance, and achievement of results by leading performance monitoring, coordinating implementing partners, supporting infrastructure rehabilitation and service delivery, and contributing to donor reporting, risk management, and results-based management. The role supports the delivery of safe, sustainable, equitable, and climate-resilient WASH services in line with national priorities, donor commitments, and UNICEF policies and standards.

item.title: WASH Officer, P2, FT, Port Sudan, Sudan - ESAR
item.description: Under the direct supervision and overall guidance of the Chief of WASH (level 5), the WASH Officer (P-2) is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, quality assurance, and timely delivery of high-quality reporting, documentation, and knowledge management products across a portfolio of donor-funded WASH programmes in Sudan. The position plays a critical role in strengthening programme monitoring, data management, results tracking, and evidence generation to ensure robust performance management, informed decision-making, and compliance with UNICEF and donor requirements

item.title: Internal Audit Manager, P-4, TA, #00138077, Office of Internal Audit & Investigation, NYHQ, Home Based
item.description: The purpose of the Manager Digital Internal Audit Services is to advise on, facilitate, oversee, and coordinate implementation of the Digital audit strategy, assess digital risks and controls across UNICEF’s digital landscape, and manage the execution of digital audit engagements.

item.title: Social Policy Specialist - Social Protection Systems, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Global Programme Division, Economic & Social Policy COE, Nairobi, #00133873
item.description: UNICEF is seeking a Social Policy Specialist (Social Protection Systems) based in Nairobi to support the expansion of inclusive, child-sensitive and shock-resilient social protection systems. The role contributes to UNICEF’s Strategic Plan by strengthening national systems through technical assistance, capacity development, policy advice, and knowledge management. Working within the Global Programme Division, the Specialist will support Country and Regional Offices and their partners, with a particular focus on Sub‑Saharan Africa, to improve programme design, implementation, and monitoring. The position also engages with regional and global partners to advance policy reform, evidence generation, and partnerships that enhance equitable access to social protection for children and families.

item.title: Immunization Specialist, (P-4), TA, #138255, (364 days), Mogadishu, Somalia, ESAR
item.description: The incumbent provides technical guidance and operational support throughout the programming process to facilitate the achievement of concrete and sustainable results, according to plans, allocation, results based-management approaches and methodology (RBM), organizational Strategic Plans and goals, standards of performance, and accountability framework ensuring immunization contributes to stronger PHC, resilient health systems, and improved health outcomes.

item.title: Chief Social Policy, P-5, FT, #00056400, Syria, Damascus - MENAR
item.description: By being the Chief Social Policy you will report to the Deputy Representative for general guidance and direction. You will be responsible for leading, managing and supervising all stages of Economic and Social Policy programming and related advocacy, from strategic planning and formulation to delivery of concrete and sustainable results. This includes programmes aimed at improving (a) public policies to reduce monetary and multidimensional child poverty; (b) inclusive, shock-responsive social protection systems and programmes; (c) the transparency, adequacy, equity and efficiency of child-focused public investments, domestic financing and financial management; (d) governance, decentralization and accountability measures to increase public participation and the quality, equity and coverage of social services, and (e) livelihoods and economic opportunities as per new UNICEF Strategic Plan. This encompasses both direct programme work with government (central and at subnational levels), international financial institutions, development partners, and civil society partners, as well as linkages and support to teams working on education, health, nutrition, child protection, and water and sanitation.

item.title: Innovation Specialist, P-4, Temporary Position, 364 days, #00138162, Global Programme Division, Generation Unlimited (YPA) secretariat, Outposted in Nairobi (Fully Remote)
item.description: Join UNICEF’s Generation Unlimited (GenU) team and help shape the future of digital livelihoods for young people around the world. As the Innovation Specialist, Youth Agency Marketplace (YOMA), you will lead the coordination, technical management and partnership delivery of YOMA, GenU’s global digital platform connecting young people to learning, employment, entrepreneurship and social impact opportunities. Working with governments, private sector partners, technology providers, donors, UNICEF Country Offices and youth-serving organizations, you will drive the implementation of YOMA’s technology roadmap, strengthen Youth Digital Identity (YoID) integration, advance YOMA’s transition as a Digital Public Good, and support country adoption across a growing global ecosystem.

item.title: Risk & Safeguarding Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Islamabad, Pakistan, #00093606, 24 Months
item.description: Join us at UNICEF Pakistan as a Risk & Safeguarding Manager where you will play a critical role in ensuring UNICEF Pakistan adheres to high level of accountability and proactively identify, assess and respond to the risks associated with the achievement of its goal and results.

item.title: Procurement Services Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Ethiopia, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, #00096880
item.description: Join our team at UNICEF Ethiopia to manage the complex and large Procurement Services (PS) function.

item.title: Senior Advisor (Economic and Social Policy and Gender Equality), P-5, Fixed Term Position, Programme Group, #00133884
item.description: The Senior Advisor (Economic & Social Policy and Gender Equality) provides strategic leadership to integrate gender equality and adolescent girls' empowerment into economic and social policies, particularly in areas like child poverty reduction and social protection. Through policy advisory, thought leadership, capacity building, and accountability to the Gender Action Plan, the role ensures gender-sensitive approaches are embedded across UNICEF’s programming and partnerships.

item.title: Business Analyst (UNITE), P-3, Temporary Position, 364 days, Office of Strategy & Evidence, Innocenti, Florence, Italy #00136560
item.description: To ensure the successful delivery of the UNITE system, a temporary appointment is required to support the development and implementation of the UNITE project. This role serves as a bridge between business stakeholders, DID and the vendor, ensuring that business requirements are clearly understood and addressed.

item.title: Chief Nutrition, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Lilongwe, Malawi, #00052247
item.description: UNICEF seeks an experienced Chief of Nutrition to lead UNICEF Malawi’s comprehensive nutrition portfolio, providing strategic direction, technical leadership and partnership coordination to strengthen nutrition systems and deliver sustainable results for children, adolescents and women across development and humanitarian contexts.

item.title: Programme Specialist (Safeguarding), P-3, TA, 364 days, #00138203, Education Cannot Wait (ECW), UNICEF Hosted Fund, Geneva, Switzerland
item.description: Education Cannot Wait (ECW) is looking for a highly motivated Programme Specialist (Safeguarding) to support and strengthen ECW’s safeguarding work across its global humanitarian education portfolio. Under the general guidance and supervision of the Chief of Education, the incumbent will play a critical role within the Programme Delivery and Quality Team, conducting Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) assessments of partner organizations, managing safeguarding incidents and concerns involving partners, and supporting safeguarding capacity-strengthening initiatives. Working closely with colleagues across the Programme Delivery and Quality, Finance, Risk & Operations, Evidence, Results and Reporting, and Partnerships, Advocacy and Resource Mobilization teams, the Programme Specialist will also engage with UNICEF colleagues through cross-divisional safeguarding forums and collaborate with ECW-funded partners to promote safe, accountable and child-centered programming.

item.title: Chief (Risk Analysis and Preparedness), P-5, Fixed Term Position, #00107500, Office of Emergency Operations, Outposted to Rome, Italy
item.description: We are looking for a dedicating Chief, who supports the Deputy Director in corporate decision-making and prioritization processes, ensuring that risks are systematically identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable recommendations for resource allocation, preparedness investment, and early action. The Chief, Risk Analysis and Preparedness also supervises the Risk and Preparedness Unit, a small team of professionals working on risk analysis and preparedness within EMOPS.

item.title: Health and Nutrition Policy Advocacy Intern, Beijing, UNICEF China, 6 months (Onsite, for Chinese nationals only)
item.description: UNICEF China is seeking a highly motivated Health and Nutrition Policy Advocacy Intern to support evidence generation, policy research, and stakeholder engagement on child health and nutrition priorities. The intern will contribute to real-world policy initiatives, working alongside UNICEF specialists, government counterparts, researchers, and development partners to advance more supportive health and nutrition policy environments for children.

item.title: Contracts Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Copenhagen, Denmark, Supply Division, #00137879
item.description: The role is expected to drive tangible improvements in access to essential medicines including pediatric cancer medicines by enhancing their availability and affordability, while application of the Healthy Markets Framework. The incumbent will contribute to building sustainable market shaping activities that support long-term, equitable access to essential medicines for children, in line with UNICEF’s global mandate. Effective management of the partnership will strengthen GPACCM delivery, improve partner satisfaction, and ensure alignment between technical implementation and partnership commitments, contributing to sustainable and scalable access models.

item.title: Comptroller and Director, Division of Finance and Management - (D-2), FT, NYHQ, USA
item.description: UNICEF is looking to hire Comptroller and Director, Division of Finance and Management. The Division of Financial and Administrative Management (DFAM) under the leadership of the UNICEF Comptroller is looking for a dynamic leader responsible for maintaining a sound system of internal controls and leading financial reforms; budget formulation and planning, including performance and financial risk management; and the establishment of systems to ensure effective and efficient use of resources and the safeguarding of UNICEF assets.
